partners.diseaseBName: partial lipodystrophy, congenital cataracts, and neurodegeneration syndrome
partners.mechanism_chain: SLC7A9 (HGNC:10893) —DISRUPTS→ Renal amino acid reabsorption; SLC3A1 (HGNC:10890) —DISRUPTS→ Renal amino acid reabsorption; Renal amino acid reabsorption —DECREASES→ Cystine; Cystine —LEADS_TO→ Cystinuria (MONDO:0009067); CAV1 (HGNC:1909) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal function; Lysosomal function —LEADS_TO→ Partial lipodystrophy, congenital cataracts, and neurodegeneration syndrome (MONDO:0011714). Mutations in SLC7A9 and SLC3A1 disrupt renal amino acid reabsorption, leading to cystine accumulation and cystinuria. Mutations in CAV1 disrupt lysosomal function, contributing to the complex phenotype of partial lipodystrophy, congenital cataracts, and neurodegeneration syndrome. The shared mechanism lies in the convergence on cellular processes that, when disrupted, manifest as distinct but related disease phenotypes.

partners.mechanism_chain: CAV1 (HGNC:1907) —DISRUPTS→ Caveolae formation and function (GO:0031249); Caveolae formation and function (GO:0031249) —LEADS_TO→ Cholesterol homeostasis (GO:0008201); Cholesterol homeostasis (GO:0008201) —LEADS_TO→ Generalized lipodystrophy (HP:0000970); SLC7A9 (HGNC:10410) —DISRUPTS→ Cystine reabsorption in renal tubules (R-HSA-195871); SLC3A1 (HGNC:10407) —DISRUPTS→ Cystine reabsorption in renal tubules (R-HSA-195871); Cystine reabsorption in renal tubules (R-HSA-195871) —LEADS_TO→ Renal stone formation (HP:0000120); Caveolae formation and function (GO:0031249) —DISRUPTS→ Cystine reabsorption in renal tubules (R-HSA-195871). Loss-of-function mutations in CAV1 disrupt caveolae formation and function, which in turn impairs cholesterol homeostasis. The convergence is on the broader cellular processes affected by CAV1, specifically caveolae and cholesterol homeostasis, which have downstream effects on both lipid metabolism and renal function.

partners.diseaseBName: epidermolysis bullosa, junctional 6, with pyloric atresia
partners.mechanism_chain: SLC7A9 (HGNC:10598) —DISRUPTS→ Amino acid transport (GO:0008544); SLC3A1 (HGNC:10597) —DISRUPTS→ Amino acid transport (GO:0008544); Amino acid transport (GO:0008544) —LEADS_TO→ Cystinuria (MONDO:0009067); ITGA6 (HGNC:5889) —DISRUPTS→ Cell-cell adhesion (GO:0007155); Cell-cell adhesion (GO:0007155) —DISRUPTS→ Basement membrane assembly (GO:0031011); Basement membrane assembly (GO:0031011) —LEADS_TO→ Epidermolysis bullosa, junctional 6, with pyloric atresia (MONDO:0859233). partners.diseaseBName: ketoacidosis due to monocarboxylate transporter-1 deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: SLC7A9/SLC3A1 (HGNC:10560) —DISRUPTS→ Renal amino acid reabsorption (GO:0015834); Renal amino acid reabsorption (GO:0015834) —LEADS_TO→ Cystinuria (MONDO:0009067); SLC16A1 (HGNC:10758) —DISRUPTS→ Monocarboxylate transport (GO:0015710); Monocarboxylate transport (GO:0015710) —DECREASES→ Lactate/Ketone bodies (CHEBI:15361); Lactate/Ketone bodies (CHEBI:15361) —LEADS_TO→ Ketoacidosis (HP:0001857). Loss-of-function mutations in SLC7A9/SLC3A1 disrupt renal amino acid reabsorption leading to cystinuria. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in SLC16A1 disrupt monocarboxylate transport, leading to accumulation of substrates like lactate and ketone bodies, causing ketoacidosis. The convergence lies in the shared principle of disrupted cellular transport impacting metabolic homeostasis, albeit through different substrate classes.

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared influence on renal tubule transport and calcium homeostasis could reveal novel therapeutic targets for both cystinuria and pulmonary hypertension, potentially involving modulators of ion channels or calcium signaling pathways that are active in both renal and pulmonary vascular smooth muscle cells.
